items.summary: Attacks linked to a network of young people obsessed with mass shooters are greatly increasing, research shared with WIRED shows, as the nihilistic group uses TikTok and AI to spread its message.

items.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
items.summary: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

items.title: Wireless Android Auto has a phone battery draining problem, but you can fix it
items.summary: Wireless Android Auto can drain your phone's battery, but a few easy adjustments can help reduce power use and keep your phone cooler while you're driving.
